written.headline: Mistral launches Studio Le Chonk platform for enterprise AI deployment
written.summary: Mistral AI announced that its Studio platform now supports the Le Chonk multimodal model, enabling enterprises to build and deploy agents, workflows and apps on cloud, VPC or on‑premises while retaining full control over data and infrastructure.
